daily.methodology: July–December 2025 complete-history cohort. Start with the mean daily balance from up to six completed pre-July account months, scale all observed inflows to 55%, and increase identified household bills by 15%. Measure end-of-day cash, then replay a conditional seven-day move of one recurring bill identified from pre-July history. Every shifted payment stays in its original month.
summary_points: 4,424 accounts met the replay data requirements.
2,324 started and closed each month nonnegative. 143 of these went negative between month-ends.
102 of the timing-shortfall accounts had a qualifying bill-date scenario. The conditional move avoided a daily shortfall for 44.
This replay assumes no fee for the date change. Historical payment records do not establish approval.
